restrictions.countryCore: scripts/prompt19-country-core.mjs exports z.enum KOR/PRK and source/feature schemas use it
restrictions.joinedCoordinator: scripts/prepare-prompt19-joined-candidates.mjs reloads coarse-world-v1 for all non-target countries; must not use for CHN incremental work
restrictions.packager: scripts/prepare-prompt19-mixed-world.mjs requires exactly two KOR/PRK source locks; automatically activates current at reuse and completion branches; exact overview cell and edge selectors KOR/PRK
restrictions.verifier: scripts/verify-prompt19-mixed-world.mjs reads current only, checks KOR/PRK unions and compares all other countries to coarse-world-v1

recommendedContract.input: Read current pointer; verify every artifact and provenance input; use exact active joined bundle as immutable predecessor
recommendedContract.target: CHN replacement records/features only. Preserve non-CHN IDs, feature properties, logical geometry, parent membership and transitive seedParentIds.
recommendedContract.topology: Remove only edges incident on replaced CHN IDs. Rebuild CHN partition and touched neighboring incidence with common noding; insert only collinear non-CHN boundary nodes and independently prove physical territory unchanged.
recommendedContract.sourceScope: Explicit adapter registry of acquired supported countries; never accept arbitrary country strings by removing validation
recommendedContract.proof: New independent incremental acceptance binds exact predecessor and candidate input bytes and inherited KOR/PRK proof plus all new source/hierarchy/code pins
recommendedContract.publish: Separate immutable packager from activation. Candidate root/catalogRef accepted only after package tiles and real-game checks. Compare current predecessor before atomic switch.
recommendedContract.fineMacro: Keep all KOR/PRK parents exact; derive only CHN parents as source-compatible whole-family quotient
recommendedContract.delivery: Dynamic explicit fineCountries from source lock artifacts and retained fine inventory; shared fill/edge LOD required at target-neighbor boundaries
